create_clock -name core_clk -period 6.666666666667 [get_ports hfextclk]

set_clock_uncertainty -hold 0.100 [all_clocks]

set_clock_transition 0.100 [all_clocks]
set_clock_gating_check -setup 0.1 -hold 0.05 [current_design]
set cps [get_ports {hfextclk lfextclk io_pads_jtag_TCK_i_ival}]

set_input_delay -min 0.2 -clock core_clk $ips
set_input_transition 0.1 [all_inputs]
set_output_delay -max 2.0 -clock core_clk [all_outputs]
set_output_delay -min 0.2 -clock core_clk [all_outputs]
set_load 0.05 [all_outputs]

set_output_delay -clock jtag_clk -max 2.0 $jo
